versions.changelog:
- Initial release of open-langchain skill.
- Automates opening the LangChain website in the user's Brave browser.
- Clicks the primary "Start building" button to take the user to the LangChain/LangSmith builder dashboard.
- Prefers using existing Brave sessions and tab management for seamless experience.
- Handles multiple call-to-action buttons by identifying the correct "Start building" option.
- Verifies dashboard loading and notifies if authentication is required.
